name: elevenlabs
summary: Successfully completed the ElevenLabs quickstart end-to-end. Installed the elevenlabs and python-dotenv packages, created example.py with the quickstart code, and ran it. The script generated a valid MP3 audio file (output.mp3, 43,511 bytes, MPEG ADTS layer III, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz) from the text "The first move is what sets everything in motion." using the George voice (JBFqnCBsd6RMkjVDRZzb) and the eleven_v3 model.
deviations: The quickstart example uses `play(audio)` to play audio through speakers, but the sandbox is headless with no audio output device. I deviated by saving the returned audio stream to a file (`output.mp3`) instead, which is a more appropriate verification for this environment and still demonstrates the core text-to-speech generation working correctly.

env_ready.evidence: Defaulting to user installation because normal site-packages is not writeable

verified.evidence: output.mp3: Audio file with ID3 version 2.4.0, contains: MPEG ADTS, layer III, v1, 128 kbps, 44.1 kHz, Monaural
